gdpr_page.title: GDPR & Cookie Policy
gdpr_page.intro: FlairSync's full GDPR compliance statement, cookie policy, data subject rights guide, and information for EU residents.
gdpr_page.cookie_categories_intro: We use four categories of cookies on our platform. Strictly necessary cookies are always active. All other cookies require your consent, which you can manage at any time.
gdpr_page.load_error_title: Unable to load GDPR & Cookie Policy
gdpr_page.load_error_description: Please try refreshing the page in a moment.
gdpr_page.contact_question: Questions about GDPR compliance or your rights?

strictly_necessary.name: Strictly Necessary
strictly_necessary.description: These cookies are essential for the platform to function. They enable core features like user authentication, session management, and security. They cannot be disabled.
strictly_necessary.examples: Authentication tokens, CSRF protection, session identifiers

functional.name: Functional
functional.description: These cookies remember your preferences and settings to provide a more personalised experience (e.g., language, theme, timezone). Disabling them may affect usability.
functional.examples: Language preference, UI theme, timezone setting

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.description: These cookies help us understand how users interact with our platform so we can improve it. All data is anonymised and aggregated. Set only with your consent.
analytics.examples: Page views, feature usage, session duration, error rates

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.description: These cookies are used to deliver relevant content and measure campaign effectiveness. We do not sell your data to advertisers. Set only with your explicit consent.

about_page.hero_subtitle: FlairSync is an all-in-one management platform for restaurants and cafés — handling reservations, menus, staff, analytics, and customer engagement from a single dashboard.
about_page.what_drives_us_subtitle: Three pillars that shape every decision we make.

values.title: Our Mission
values.description: FlairSync exists to give every restaurant and café owner—big or small—the same powerful technology that enterprise chains use. We simplify reservations, menus, orders, and customer feedback into a single seamless platform.

values.title: Our Vision
values.description: A world where hospitality businesses thrive through technology. We build for real-time insights, smart analytics, and customer satisfaction tools that drive sustainable growth.

values.title: Security & Trust
values.description: Data privacy is non-negotiable. FlairSync uses encrypted storage, role-based access control, and is fully compliant with modern data-protection standards so your business is always protected.

about_page.our_story_title: Built from a real problem, not a whiteboard
about_page.our_story_paragraph1: FlairSync was born after seeing how many restaurant owners struggled with fragmented tools — one app for reservations, another for menus, spreadsheets for staff. We set out to unify all of that into one platform that actually makes sense to use.
about_page.our_story_paragraph2: Today we power hundreds of restaurants across 12+ countries, and we're just getting started. Every feature we ship comes directly from conversations with the operators who use it every day.
principles: Built for speed — every feature ships fast and works reliably
